global_boundaries: Nominal outcomes in the tested sample are not a formal or real-road safety guarantee.
Seven supervisor channels are toggled together, so individual-rule effects are not isolated.
SF4 authority-off failure saturation prevents a clean no-masking or selective-masking conclusion.
Foundation, V3, R3, SF4, timing-shift, threshold-gap and legacy-smoke records are never pooled.
Similar trajectories do not by themselves identify masking rather than controller insensitivity, inactive constraints, fallback, target response or limited power.

H1.candidate_control_outcome: supervisor request, bypass/fallback path and candidate-minus-nominal command magnitude
H1.claimable_conclusion: Complete authority achieved nominal yielding and completion in all tested authority-on SF4 rollouts if canonical reconciliation passes.
H1.executed_outcome: completion, yield-rule compliance, collisions, minimum footprint separation and executed-command replacement
H1.falsification_rule: Refute the tested-sample effectiveness claim if authority-on rollouts do not consistently yield and complete, or exhibit adverse collisions/yield-order failures incompatible with the claim.
H1.name: Nominal physical yielding under complete supervisor authority
H1.population_boundary: Town05 right-hand-traffic ego-left-turn versus opposing-straight target; 10 paired SF4 initialisation groups and the complete channel bundle only.
H1.treatment: complete seven-channel supervisor authority on versus monitor-only off

H2.candidate_control_outcome: aligned nominal SMPC command separation when available
H2.claimable_conclusion: Capacity, Information and Architecture change bounded prediction, while current evidence tests whether rather than presumes supervisor-specific masking.
H2.executed_outcome: supervisor intervention, executed command and completion/separation outcomes
H2.falsification_rule: Refute supervisor-induced masking if predictor distinctions transfer without additional authority-linked attenuation; treat absent aligned or non-saturated authority contrasts as unidentified rather than confirmation.
H2.independent_unit: offline ego initialisation group for CIA; V3 paired ego_init_id for deployed transfer
H2.name: Predictor advantage transfer through the supervised stack
H2.population_boundary: CIA and V3 are separate populations; only actually deployed matched policies license physical-transfer statements.

subquestions.Architecture: matched MLP versus Transformer direct gap and history-gain interaction
subquestions.Capacity: small, medium and large Transformer tiers at fixed full history
subquestions.Information: 0.0, 0.4 and 1.0 second histories within matched families

H2.treatment: matched predictor contrasts, including B1 versus validation-frozen P* where deployed
H2.upstream_outcome: rollout-macro mixture NLL, top-1 ADE/FDE and in-loop prediction error

H3.candidate_control_outcome: aligned nominal SMPC command separation and solver/fallback status
H3.claimable_conclusion: Adaptive risk is evaluated across the full fixed frontier and any physical similarity is decomposed before masking language is used.
H3.executed_outcome: supervisor intervention, executed command, completion and minimum footprint separation
H3.falsification_rule: Refute supervisor-induced masking if risk-policy candidate distinctions pass through authority unchanged; if constraint or nominal-command differences are already absent, attribute no unique supervisor mechanism.
H3.independent_unit: R3 ego_init_cluster; V3/SF4 ego_init_id, reported separately
H3.name: Risk-allocation distinction transfer through the supervised stack
H3.population_boundary: R3 full fixed frontier, V3 selected-model cells, SF4 authority cells and licensed legacy timing evidence remain unpooled.
prohibited_overclaims: the supervisor alone causes all risk-policy similarity
H3.treatment: adaptive allocation versus every declared fixed-risk frontier comparator
H3.upstream_outcome: per-mode allocation, target probability, tightening and constraint activity where logged

paper_argument: In the tested Town05 right-hand-traffic left-turn give-way task, complete rule-based supervisor authority achieved nominal physical yielding, while predictor and risk-allocation distinctions did not uniformly transfer to executed behaviour; causal masking is reserved for aligned or non-saturated intervention contrasts that identify the supervisor mechanism.

behavioural_sequence: decelerate and yield outside the conflict region
resume after target clearance and complete the route
